user.title: Connect your MyPup account
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should authenticate with MyPup.

cookie.title: Connect via Session Cookie
cookie.description:
1. Open [MyPup Login]({auth_url}) and sign in with **Remember Me** checked.
2. Open DevTools → **Network**, click any `login.mypup.app` request (e.g. `authorize` or `checksession`), and copy its **Request Headers → `cookie`** value.

token.title: Connect via Access Token
token.description:
Open [MyPup Login]({auth_url}) and sign in, then on `mypup.app` open DevTools Console and run:
`{console_cmd}`

initial_options.title: Configure MyPup Options
initial_options.description: Set your preferred polling and parcel options (you can change these later under Configure).
